sn11.21:1.2: Then Sakka, lord of the devas, approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, and stood to one side.
sn11.21:1.3: Standing to one side, Sakka, lord of the devas, addressed the Blessed One in verse:
sn11.21:2.1: “Having slain what does one sleep soundly?
sn11.21:2.2: Having slain what does one not sorrow?
sn11.21:2.3: What is the one thing, O Gotama,
sn11.21:3.1:
The Blessed One:
“Having slain anger, one sleeps soundly;
sn11.21:3.2: Having slain anger, one does not sorrow;
sn11.21:3.3: The killing of anger, O Vasava,
sn11.21:3.4: With its poisoned root and honeyed tip:
sn11.21:3.5: This is the killing the noble ones praise,
sn11.21:3.6: For having slain that, one does not sorrow.”
